audit.why: Cassiopeia bullies levels 1-3 against a melee frame with no ranged answer, it evens at 4 on Wuju Style, and Yi owns 6 through first item before her lockdown reclaims it. Consistent with 43.8% over 121 games — her worst row in this slice.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 and first-item spikes named Highlander and 'his Q dash' with no cooldowns, so there was no window to play around.
audit.why: Highlander is 85s and Alpha Strike is 20/19.5/19/18.5/18s at rank 1 — a 20-second dash is an enormous punish window for a champion whose whole plan is sticking to you, and Highlander passively shortens his other cooldowns.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text and mid now carry 85s and 20s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single decisive interaction in this matchup was absent: Highlander makes Yi immune to all slowing effects, which blanks Miasma's slow and the back-turned half of Petrifying Gaze — while leaving the grounding and the stun fully intact. The pages instead sold Miasma generically as 'the W slow-zone'. Twin Fang was also written as 'ramped E's'.
audit.why: Riot's Highlander text: making him immune to all slowing effects. Riot's Miasma text: slowing, grounding, and lightly damaging — grounded enemies cannot use Movement abilities. Grounding is not a slow, so it survives Highlander and still shuts off Alpha Strike. Riot's Petrifying Gaze text: stuns enemies facing her, slows those with their back turned — so under Highlander the back-turned half does nothing and only the face-on stun matters. Separately, Meditate is a channel and Petrifying Gaze cancels it outright, and Alpha Strike makes him untargetable in transit.
audit.corrected: Highlander's slow immunity, the surviving grounding, the surviving stun, the Meditate cancel and the Alpha Strike untargetability are now stated across spikes[1..3], mid, late, whys[4..6] and wants.you[1..2]; Twin Fang named correctly.

audit.whatIsWrong: Meditate sustain was never given an itemisation answer.
audit.why: Meditate is a 10s heal channel; Grievous Wounds is the standard answer and the missing-interactions file flags this matchup as needs-antiheal.
audit.corrected: Not written — there is no writable itemisation field in the content layer for this matchup and Master Yi has no CHAMP_FULL entry under cassiopeia, so breakdown/report are unavailable. Recorded here instead.
